title: A7-RT Node Status Transitions
description: Valid state transitions for A7-RT nodes. Poison (POISONED) is always a valid destination.

near.description: Initial state - one step away from grounded

poisoned.description: Terminal state - node failed validation (roots can be unpoisoned for retry)

invariants: Poison is always a valid destination from any state
Grounded is terminal except for cross-stage poison
Suspended can return to near for retry
